swap_occurred.meaning: a swap has been executed on the pair

identical_swap_on_both.meaning: the same swap is executed on both the forked pair and the reference pair

fork_lp_value_after.meaning: LP portfolio value after the identical swap on the forked pair

reference_lp_value_after.meaning: LP portfolio value after the identical swap on the reference Uniswap-like pair

assumptions: The reference pair implements standard Uniswap V2 fee behavior, allowing a fair comparison of LP portfolio value.

unresolved.description: No numeric definition or unit for LP portfolio value is supplied; the comparison is symbolic.

limitations: Only the direct LP portfolio decline impact i_lp_portfolio_drop is bound; value leak, fee erosion, and arbitrage extraction impacts are deferred.
The invariant relation itself is not separately formalized; this plan expresses the invariant-proxy condition that fork LP value must not decline relative to the reference pair.
Symbolic value units are used because the report provides no concrete reserve, swap, or portfolio amounts.
